pages.text: The $(l)Gem Leggings$(), or $(o)Gravity Greaves$(), are the Gem Armor leg piece. Craft them from Red Matter Leggings, a Black Hole Band, a Watch of Flowing Time and a $(l)fully charged Klein Star Omega$().$(br2)While you sneak they push nearby creatures away from you.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Sneaking repels all nearby entities and projectiles in a small radius (about 3.5 blocks).$(li)If you slam down quickly while sneaking, nearby mobs below you take impact damage. Diving is a fast fall, so the Gem Boots glide will not protect you from it.$(li)Sneaking in mid-air adds a small downward push to help you descend quickly.$(li)Part of the Gem set, which reduces damage by roughly 63%.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() common.crafting.fullKleinStars applies to the recipe.
